decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample shift in N/E around indices 487–490 with persistent offset, and (2) a prolonged low-E/U platform from ~608–622 with emerging N recovery, hinting at complex superposed motion. Other segments show noisy or smooth trends without clear morphological anomalies.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 487–490, followed by a sustained offset; U component shows a concurrent but less pronounced dip. The change appears abrupt and not fully recovered within the window.

Extended plateau-like behavior in E (strongly negative) and U (moderately negative) from ~608 to 622, preceded by a steep descent in E at ~606–607; N shows a delayed rise starting ~612, suggesting possible opposing motion or superposed signal.
